transcript.text: In React, I avoid unnecessary re-renders by keeping state close to where it is used, splitting large components, and memoizing expensive computations with useMemo. I only use React.memo or useCallback when profiling shows the component actually needs it.

transcript.text: For slow PostgreSQL queries I start with EXPLAIN ANALYZE. In one case, a missing composite index on a join and filter path caused an 800 ms query. Adding the index brought it down to around 12 ms.
